Building Services 32BJ Benefit Funds administers health, pension, retirement savings, training, and legal services benefits to SEIU 32BJ members. The Junior Full Stack Developer designs, codes, tests, deploys, configures, and maintains software applications while supporting databases, integrations, development environments, production systems, and CI/CD activities.
Education
Non Profit
Training
Responsibilities
Assist in developing and maintaining new and existing applications, systems, custom reports, and database structures
Participate in requirement analysis along with Business Analysts and business users
Design and develop various modules under guidance and work with other developers and IT staff as required
Write well-designed, testable, and efficient code that adheres to security standards, team coding standards, and best practices
Assist in developing and designing database schema, SQL queries, and stored procedures
Develop and test simple features and bug fixes. Debug applications with the guidance of senior developer
Support front end integrations
Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback
Use version control system
Assist in build and deployment process
Support CI/CD pipeline activities
Help maintain test and development environments
Provide Production and End User Support Activities as needed
Assist in estimating effort involved in completing various development tasks
Plan and prioritize assigned activities
Report activities and progress to management and senior team members on a regular basis
Work on multiple tasks and projects simultaneously in a team environment
Create and update system and API documentation and design specifications
Research and learn new and existing technologies to meet business needs, including assisting with prototypes and solution designs
Perform tasks as required by management/supervisory staff
Provide support after hours or on weekends for emergency issues and production releases as required

Experience or academic exposure to HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and at least one modern framework such as React, Angular, or Vue
